decision.reason: W3-10 through W3-13 are all runtime NOT_STARTED; reviewed plans and isolated preflight receipts cannot form a same-release cumulative EvidencePack

upstreamMatrix.gap: W3-01 through W3-09 runtime and five-layer EvidencePack are absent
content/campaign authorities and full stack are absent
operations case/policy/SLA/kill authorities and full stack are absent
analyst insight/plan/task-graph/effect authorities and full stack are absent

requiredSameReleaseIdentity: git commit and immutable application release
schema and migration or no-migration proof

cumulativeAxes.contract: public orchestration and all three domain contracts exact and mutually compatible
cumulativeAxes.store: authority rows, RLS, CAS, idempotency, lineage and restart readback
cumulativeAxes.apiSdk: canonical operations, stable errors and strict DTO parsing
cumulativeAxes.web: eight Modules use one public production component package and expose authoritative lifecycle state
cumulativeAxes.browser: formal HTTP at 1280/1440/1920 with keyboard, focus, console and network evidence
cumulativeAxes.securityTenant: org-org positive, dev-org negative, minimum disclosure and no cross-tenant refs
cumulativeAxes.recoveryReplay: duplicate/out-of-order input, partial failure, unknown outcome, restart/rebuild and successor correction

crossDomainRules: Campaign, OperationCase and GrowthPlan authorities remain domain-owned and never become second Task, Handoff, Action, Approval or Receipt truth.
Cross-domain work is coordinated by exact refs through canonical Task/Handoff/Action primitives, not by a hidden distributed transaction.
A partial or unknown cross-domain result stays visible and reconcileable; it cannot be collapsed into success or erased by retry.
Every domain projection can rebuild from canonical authorities while preserving historical predecessor/successor reachability and quantity conservation.

gateRule.pass: W3-10, W3-11, W3-12 and W3-13 are runtime GREEN on one exact release identity and all seven cumulative axes are GREEN in one signed EvidencePack
gateRule.failClosed: any missing, stale, unknown, cross-release, negative-only or synthetic-positive axis keeps W3-14 RED

tests.reason: The runtime cumulative gate cannot execute while all four upstream runtime items are NOT_STARTED.

next: Remediate the W3-14 plan into a same-release seven-axis cumulative matrix, keep W3-14 unchecked, and re-evaluate only after W3-10 through W3-13 runtime receipts are all exact and current.
